newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end lower on mixed selling.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end lower on mixed selling.

text.p: Mixed selling limited an early rally and pressured NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures to settle lower, market sources said.

Local buying and speculative profit-taking lifted prices early from fresh contract lows made Monday. But trade scale-up selling limited gains at 91.00 cents in March, and local profit-taking pushed prices below unchanged.
Pressure from the speculators and the locals later in the session contributed to losses, dealers said.
March juice ended 0.35 lower at 85.85 traded 91.00 to 89.50. Spot January eased 0.50 on the day to 82.40, while the deferred contracts finished unchanged to 1.00 higher.

While the market is oversold from a technical point of view, weather forecasts calling for above normal temperatures for the next six to 10 days, could weigh heavily on prices, Celeste Georgakis, vice preisdent with Dean Witter, said.
